messages:
mira: Quick sync  dropping the latest invite-drawer mock (Figma link). Main asks: reduce visual density of roles matrix, rethink SSO toggle phrasing/placement, and add a small 'jump to audit' pattern from the invite flow so admins can see invite activity quickly. Thoughts?

devin: skimmed. my first reaction: rows feel cramped when there are role descriptions. recommend +6px vertical padding and stronger 1px divider (token: border-muted) to help scan. also make column headers sticky on long lists.

kevin: agree on padding. implementation note: sticky headers + virtualization needs careful sticky-offset calc with drawer chrome. also the row focus ring contrast is low at 1.8:1 against bg  needs at least 3:1.

tara: copy nit: current SSO label reads "Enforce SSO" which seems terse and alarm-y. propose "Require SSO for invited users" + helptext link ("Why this?" opens a micro modal explaining domain allowlists and blocked invites).

sam: accessibility: tab order currently goes email input -> invite button -> roles grid. Screen reader users miss the role summary. Suggest adding aria-live element announcing "Showing X roles" when drawer opens and when filter changes. Also ensure checkboxes announce "Role: <name>, selected".

ui-lint-bot: a11y scan: text color .role-meta fails contrast (3.2:1). SSO toggle missing aria-label. keyboard focus outline uses color-only indicator.

mira: good points. For the audit shortcut UX, idea: a small inline link under the invite CTA: "View invite audit entries " that deep-links to audit log with pre-filled filters (org + actor + event=invite). If deep-link isn't possible, open audit in right panel & show a "Back to Invite" control. Copy suggestions?

devin: "View invite audit entries" is clearer than "related audit entries". Ensure link is keyboard-focusable and sized hit-target >= 44px.

kevin: deep-linking is doable but we should preserve context. If we navigate away, add a toast with "Back to Invite" that returns focus to drawer. Or open audit in a new right-hand panel to keep continuity. I'll check with eng on panel feasibility.

tara: also can we add a small tooltip on the audit link explaining retention (e.g., "Audit logs retained 90 days on Standard plan"). prevents confusion when users don't see older events.

sam: for keyboard nav: add a skip link at top of drawer (visually hidden until focused) "Jump to roles matrix" and ensure role count is read on open. Also support arrow-key navigation within role rows for faster selection.

mira: action items: 1) update mock spacing + sticky header variant, 2) increase hover/focus contrast tokens, 3) change SSO copy + aria-label + help modal content, 4) add "View invite audit entries" deep-link + back-to-drawer pattern, 5) add aria-live role count + skip link, 6) run axe after updates and iterate. I'll post PR with two micro variants for PM A/B: "compact with icons" and "spacious no-icons."

devin: nice. please include alt states: zero roles, filtered results, and long role names wrapping.

kevin: will validate deep-link constraints and reply in this thread by EOD. If panel isn't feasible, we'll implement anchor + toast fallback.

tara: one more micro copy tweak: invite textarea placeholder should be "Enter emails or paste a list (one per line)" to reduce parsing errors.

mira: thanks all, will update mocks and checklist. :thumbsup:

ui-lint-bot: reminder: after updates run automated a11y scan. If failures appear, file in #eng-oncall with tag @eng-oncall.
